stringa: Consensus (MCP, piano gratuito, 10 risultati per query), 2026-09-29: q1 'randomized trial ferric derisomaltose versus ferric carboxymaltose'; q2 'iron isomaltoside 1000 compared with ferric carboxymaltose randomized hypophosphatemia'; q3 'Monofer versus Ferinject randomised controlled trial'. 30 risultati; importati solo quelli assenti dal DB e riconducibili a un DOI verificato su Crossref.

note.10.1210/js.2019-or13-3: [Estratto dall'abstract restituito da Consensus; Crossref non ha l'abstract] In two separate, identically designed, open label randomized controlled trials, we 1:1 randomized 245 adults with IDA to receive IIM (single infusion of 1000 mg) or FCM (FDA-approved dosing schedule: 2 infusions of 750 mg administered 1 week apart). [...] In pooled analyses of both trials, the incidence of hypophosphatemia <2 mg/dL was higher in the FCM versus IIM group (74.4% versus 8.0%, p<0.0001). Hypophosphatemia persisted at day 35 in 43.0% of FCM-treated patients compared to 0.9% of IIM-treated patients (p<0.0001). Severe hypophosphatemia ≤1 mg/dL occurred in 11.3% of FCM-treated patients compared to 0.0% of IIM-treated patients (p<0.0001). [...] Serious or severe hypersensitivity reactions occurred in 0.8% in the IIM group and 1.7% in the FCM group.
note.10.1093/ecco-jcc/jjy222.847: [Estratto dall'abstract restituito da Consensus; Crossref non ha l'abstract] A prospective cluster-randomised comparative two-centre study was conducted at Akershus university hospital (AHUS) and Oslo university hospital Ullevål (OUS Ullevål) over 1.5-years involving adult IBD patients with ID or IDA. Patients presenting at AHUS were treated with 1000 mg IIM and at OUS Ullevål they received 1000 mg FCM. [...] 130 patients were recruited. Fifty-two patients at OUS Ullevål and 54 patients at AHUS were included in the per protocol analysis.
